items: Root node: tree ka sab se pehla ya sab se oopar wala node, jaise computer ka main folder jis ke andar baqi saare folders aur files hote hain.

Edges aur nodes: tree ke alag alag elements nodes hain, aur unhein jorne wali lines edges kehlati hain. Jis node ka koi child node na ho use leaf (patta) kehte hain, jaise folder mein rakhi file jis ke andar aur kuch nahi.
Height (unchai): root node se sab se door leaf tak ka sab se lamba raasta tree ki height hai. Yeh batati hai ke tree kitna gehra ya uncha hai.
Balanced trees: jab baen aur daen shaakhon ki height taqreeban barabar ho to tree balanced kehlata hai. Details section 4.1.7 mein hain.

blocks.text: Neeche Python classes se family tree banane ki saada misal hai. Is mein family members (nodes) banaye jate hain aur un ke children (aulad) jore jate hain.

blocks.caption: Sahi code

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"class FamilyMember:": har family member ek node hai. "__init__" mein us ka name aur children ki khali list banti hai.
"class FamilyTree:": poora tree. "__init__" mein ancestor (sab se bara buzurg) ka node root banta hai.
"def add_child(self, parent_name, child_name):": pehle _find_member se parent dhoondta hai; mil jaye to us ke children mein naya FamilyMember jorta hai. Parent na mile (None) to kuch nahi karta.
"def _find_member(self, current_member, name):": recursion (function ka khud ko dobara bulana) se dhoondta hai: agar maujooda member ka naam mil gaya to wahi wapas; warna har child ke andar dhoondta hai; kahin na mile to None.
"family_tree = FamilyTree('Grandparent')": root Grandparent ke saath tree banta hai.
"add_child(...)" wali chaar lines: Grandparent ke neeche Parent1 aur Parent2, aur Parent1 ke neeche Child1 aur Child2 jorte hain (Figure 4.6 wala tree).
Yeh code sirf tree banata hai; is mein koi print nahi, is liye chalane par screen par kuch nahi aata (output khali). Tree dekhna ho to aakhir mein print([c.name for c in family_tree.root.children]) jaisi line likhni paregi, jo ['Parent1', 'Parent2'] dikhayegi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein chhapa hua code nahi chalta (pehli ghalti par hi SyntaxError). Is mein: Fami1yMember (1 ke saath), _ _init_ _ (space ke saath), ek line par do statements, FamilyTre e, naamon ke beech spaces (an c e s t o r _ n am e, ctii 1 d_name), parent_name ke baad ) ghayab, current.member (sahi current_member), ghalat indentation, # ki jagah •, tirchhe quotes ’, aur Parenti/Childl (sahi Parent1/Child1). Upar sahi code hai, jo Python 3.13 mein chala kar check kiya gaya.

items: FamilyMember class ek shakhs ko dikhati hai. Har shakhs ka naam (name) aur bachchon ki list (children) hoti hai.
FamilyTree class poore tree ko sambhalti hai, jo root par buzurg (ancestor) se shuru hota hai. Is mein bachche jorne (add_child) aur kisi member ko dhoondne (_find_member) ke functions hain.
add_child pehle _find_member se parent (maa ya baap) dhoondta hai, phir us ki children list mein naya FamilyMember jor deta hai.
_find_member root se shuru kar ke har node dekhta hai; naam mil jaye to wohi node lauta deta hai, warna har bachche ke andar dobara (recursion se) dhoondta hai, aur kahin na mile to None lautata hai.

blocks.text: Code chalne ke baad yeh tree banta hai: Grandparent ke do bachche Parent1 aur Parent2, aur Parent1 ke do bachche Child1 aur Child2. Figure 4.6 mein har node ek circle (daira) hai aur arrows (teer) parent se child ki taraf hain.

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure circles ka family tree: oopar Grandparent se Parent2 aur Parent1 ki taraf teer; Parent1 se Child2 aur Child1 ki taraf teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.6: Family tree ki shakal (kitab ki Figure 4.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yeh program Figure 4.6 wale family tree se root, leaf nodes, edges ki ginti aur height nikalta hai. parent mein naya member jorein, maslan "Baby": "Child1", aur Run kar ke dekhein ke height (unchai) kaise badalti hai.

parent = {"Parent1": "Grandparent", "Parent2": "Grandparent", "Child1": "Parent1", "Child2": "Parent1"}

heights = list()
for member in parent:
    if member not in parent.values():     # nobody's parent: a leaf
        print("Leaf:", member)
    node, edges = member, 0
    while node in parent:                 # climb up to the root
        node = parent[node]
        edges = edges + 1
    heights.append(edges)
print("Root:", node)
print("Edges:", len(parent), " Height:", max(heights))

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"parent = {...}": dictionary jo har member ka parent batati hai, maslan "Child1" ka parent "Parent1". Root (Grandparent) ka koi parent nahi, is liye woh key nahi.
"heights = list()": har member ki root se doori (edges) jama hogi.
"for member in parent:": har member baari baari.
"if member not in parent.values():": jo kisi ka parent nahi, woh leaf (aakhri node, jis ke children nahi) hai; use chhapta hai.
"node, edges = member, 0" aur "while node in parent:": member se oopar parent, phir us ka parent... root tak chadhta hai aur har qadam par edges 1 barhata hai.
"heights.append(edges)": is member ki root se doori.
"print("Root:", node)": loop ke baad node mein root hi bachta hai (jis ka koi parent nahi).
"print("Edges:", len(parent), " Height:", max(heights))": har member (root ke siwa) ki ek edge hoti hai, is liye edges = 4; height sab se gehri doori hai.
Output: "Leaf: Parent2", "Leaf: Child1", "Leaf: Child2", "Root: Grandparent", aur "Edges: 4  Height: 2" (label mein space ki wajah se Height se pehle do spaces aati hain).
Khud try karein: parent mein "Baby": "Child1" jor kar Run karein: Child1 ab leaf nahi rahega, Baby leaf banega, aur "Edges: 5  Height: 3" aayega.

blocks.prompt: Tree ki height ke baare mein kya sach hai (MCQ 8)?
blocks.explanation: (a) Root se sab se gehre node tak edges ki ginti. Yeh kitab ki definition (tareef) 'root se sab se door leaf tak sab se lamba raasta' se milti hai.

items: Tree ke terms (khaas alfaaz): root, nodes, edges, leaf, height.
FamilyTree class har shakhs ke bachche children list mein rakhti hai.
